metadata.note: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B is built on the Qwen2 tokenizer, so its prompt-token counts are identical to qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct (verified property of the distill release; the tokenizer repo itself was not separately re-downloaded because hf-mirror refused repeated connections on 2026-10-14). This means tokenizer probes ALONE cannot distinguish Qwen2.5 from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen - an honest limitation; behavioral probes or model-size probes would be needed. Behavioral distributions are NOT captured (see Zenodo 176 CC-BY-4.0 citation).
